{{Quote|Onca, you and your brother have been a legendary team. This challenge may prove difficult with you alone.|Dooku, to Onca, after Bulduga's death|<ref name="The Box" />}}
'''Bulduga''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He and his brother, [[Onca/Legends|Onca]], became a legendary team of [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters and caught the attention of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. The Count intended to recruit five bounty hunters to kidnap [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the Republic and invited twelve, including Bulduga and Onca, to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] to [[Tournament on Serenno/Legends|test]] their skills. However, Bulduga was [[Death/Legends|killed]] prior to the competition by fellow bounty hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] for his [[Hat/Legends|hat]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Nice hat. Where did you get it?|Cad Bane, shortly before killing Bulduga|audio=NiceHat-TB.flac|<ref name="The Box" />}}
Bulduga was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="The Box" /> from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]]<ref name="SWI132" /> who lived during the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Bulduga and [[Onca/Legends|Onca]] were amongst a group of Ithorian mutineers who reclaimed the ''[[Ottega Dawn]]'' [[Ithorian Herdship|herdship]] after it was [[Capture of the Ottega Dawn|captured]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the early months of the war.<ref name="SWBlogGunslingers1">{{SW|url=news/so-uncivilized-great-gunslingers-in-star-wars-part-1|series=So Uncivilized: Great Gunslingers in Star Wars|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> Together with his brother Onca, Bulduga became a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], and they formed a team which gained legendary status.<ref name="The Box" /> While his brother favored finesse over firepower, Bulduga fancied himself as a fast-drawing [[Gunslinger/Legends|gunslinger]].<ref name="SWEBulduga">{{SWE|characters|bulduga|Bulduga}}</ref><ref name="SWEOnca">{{SWE|characters|onca|Onca}}</ref> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011" /> Bulduga and Onca caught the attention of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], who invited the Ithorians to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. There, the Count planned to test the abilities and skills of several well-known [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters to find a team worthy for a mission the Count had prepared&mdash;the kidnapping of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="The Box" />

[[File:OncaBulduga-TB.png|thumb|left|240px|Bulduga and Onca await the arrival of Moralo Eval on Serenno.]]
On Serenno, the bounty hunters were to face the [[Box/Legends|Box]], a huge structure filled with a number of deathtraps. The five bounty hunters who survived in the Box were to be taken for the mission. After arriving on Serenno, Bulduga and Onca, as well as the bounty hunters [[Embo/Legends|Embo]], [[Sinrich/Legends|Sinrich]], [[Kiera Swan/Legends|Kiera Swan]], [[Twazzi/Legends|Twazzi]], [[Sixtat/Legends|Sixtat]], [[Derrown/Legends|Derrown]], [[Jakoli/Legends|Jakoli]], and [[Mantu/Legends|Mantu]], awaited the arrival of [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]], the constructor of the Box. When Eval arrived, he brought another two bounty hunters with him&mdash;the famed [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]], a marksman from the planet [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]]. However, when the trio and Dooku met with the rest of the bounty hunters, Bane spotted Bulduga's wide-brimmed [[Hat/Legends|hat]] and inquired where the Ithorian had got it. Bulduga responded by drawing his [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], but Bane was quicker; he [[Death/Legends|shot]] Bulduga and took his [[Hat/Legends|hat]]. Onca did nothing to avenge his brother's death and ultimately died during the [[Tournament on Serenno/Legends|competition]] in the Box.<ref name="The Box" />

==Personality and traits==
Bulduga was an Ithorian,<ref name="The Box" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] known to be peaceful.<ref name="SWEBulduga" /> However, he and Onca differed much from other Ithorians and became deadly bounty hunters.<ref name="SWEBulduga" /><ref name="The Box" /> Bulduga favored a fast-drawn [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] pistol and was able to become a quick gunslinger, despite his Ithorian bulk.<ref name="SWEBulduga" /><ref name="SWEOnca" /> However, when challenged by Bane, he was not quick enough to beat the famous Duros and was killed.<ref name="The Box" /> Bulduga wore a wide-brimmed hat, [[Color/Legends|red]]-lensed goggles, and a low-slung holster. That led some people to wonder if Bulduga tried to copy Bane, although no one dared to ask the Ithorian. Bulduga and his brother were well known in their line of work and were considered a legendary team and some of the best bounty hunters during the Clone Wars.<ref name="SWEBulduga" /><ref name="The Box" /> Bulduga had brown skin and stood 2.27 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="SWI132" /> His preferred weapon was a modified Luxan [[Penetrator MB-450]].<ref name="SWBlogGunslingers1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bulduga first appeared without any spoken lines in "[[The Box]]," the seventeenth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. He also received an entry in the [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|Encyclopedia]] on [[StarWars.com]] and was mentioned in the "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]]" article in [[Star Wars Insider 132|''Star Wars Insider'' 132]].
